abilities.name: Framing: Freezing Point Composition
_curatorNotes: behavior changed from generator-stub 'stance' to 'instant'. Charlotte's Composition Mode (Hold) is a caster aiming state — normals/charge are NOT replaced. Not a stance per recipe table.
generator-stub 'duration: 15' removed. That value was the Composition Mode max hold time (not an entity lifetime); no summons[] authored for the marks (see below).
Press frames authored as base 'frames'. Press cooldownStartDelay = 29f (skillPressDelay from gcsim).

Hold variant has variable frame duration: gcsim total animation = hold + skillHoldFrames[next], where hold is a runtime parameter (range 1–809f, min hitmark = hold+111). Post-release cancel frames (min hold=1): swap=134+1=135, N=132+1=133, Q=130+1=131, E=130+1=131; D and J default to AnimationLength (137+1=138) — not real cancels. Hold cooldownStartDelay is also variable: hitmark-2 = (hold+111)-2 = hold+109 (minimum ~110f).

Snappy Silhouette and Focused Impression marks are enemy-targeted periodic DMG sources (AttackTagElementalArt, ICDTagCharlotteMark / ICDGroupCharlotteMark), ticking every 90f (1.5s). Not spawned entities — not modeled as summons[]. Reviewer to decide representation. Press mark: 360+48=408f (~6.8s); Hold mark: 720+54=774f (~12.9s).

abilities.name: Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation
abilities.description:
Condensing ice to create The Steambird's signature, Charlotte creates a Newsflash Field that will deal AoE Cryo DMG and restores HP for all nearby party members based on Charlotte's ATK.
Newsflash Field
·While the ability is active, Monsieur Verite will deal Cryo DMG at intervals to opponents within its AoE.
·Will continuously restore HP to active character(s) within its AoE based on Charlotte's ATK.

Damage tagged as AttackTagElementalBurst, ICDTagNone, Cryo, 25 durability. Likely 'onHit' trigger with ability condition (normal/chargeAttack), mark condition (focusedImpression), procCooldown=6s. constellations.description: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by Framing: Freezing Point Composition's Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.
